requirements.requirement: The system must include an eligibility_strictness_score field in each clinical trial object returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate eligibility_strictness_score using the output from the scoring logic implemented in clinical_trials_service.
The system must ensure the eligibility_strictness_score value is a normalized float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must preserve all existing response fields and structure in evaluate_care_facade without removing or renaming any existing attributes.
The system must include the eligibility_strictness_score for every clinical trial in list responses, not just a subset.
The system must ensure compatibility with existing chat tool layer consumers by maintaining response schema validation against clinical_trials_models.
The system must not recompute the eligibility strictness score in the facade layer and must rely on precomputed values from the domain service.
The system must return a null eligibility_strictness_score when the scoring logic fails to produce a value for a trial.
The system must continue returning clinical trial results even if eligibility_strictness_score is null for one or more trials.
The system must handle missing eligibility criteria data from upstream services by setting eligibility_strictness_score to null without raising an unhandled exception.
The system must raise a controlled error or fallback response if the clinical_trials_service dependency (EVAL-CT-M7-S2) is unavailable or fails completely.
The system must ensure that the addition of eligibility_strictness_score does not increase response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined for evaluate_care_facade.
